Use the `psm-project-manager` agent for this request.

Choose or confirm the next useful vertical slice, route the planning work to the right internal specialist, and return with:

- the selected slice;
- the intended outcome;
- included and deferred scope;
- readiness status;
- any blocking findings;
- whether a maintainer approval gate must be crossed before implementation begins.
